trap-superlative.evidence: 'the partial ladder Q_{N=2}(q_0) evaluates to within 5.6 ppm of Q_beta^CODATA with zero CODATA input' is unqualified on two counts that I verified against the block's own witness (computations/qbeta/qbeta-symbolic-chain-alpha-b.witness.json). (1) CONVENTION. That witness computes z = 1/(sqrt(q) + 1/sqrt(q)) = 0.4993203342, which is convention C - excised by the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 in favour of D (z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6126880371). z is load-bearing here, not cosmetic: alpha = (z-1)h/2 feeds alpha_eff = alpha - b*hbar^2/2 and hence the cos(alpha_eff) factor of the displayed ladder. I reproduced the witness exactly under C at the muon pin (eps_N0 = 1681.9, eps_N1 = 78.156, eps_N2 = 5.60699 ppm, all matching to the digits recorded) and then re-ran the identical chain under D: eps_N1 = 679.36 and eps_N2 = 606.76 ppm. The headline 5.6 ppm is therefore 108x worse under the canonical convention, and the block carries no C-conditional label. (2) 'zero CODATA input' - q_0 itself is pinned on a CODATA mass ratio, so the honest claim is 'no fit to the CODATA Q_beta value'.
